You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Do not refill furosemide. Tell her lisinopril has no refills, send a renewal request to Dr. Patel, give a rough 1 to 2 business day timeline.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hello honey, it's Gloria Hart. I need the water pill...
[#2] AGENT: Hi Gloria! I'd be happy to help you with your water pill. Let me pull up your information first—can you give me your date of birth?
CALLER: Oh, wait, honey, no, not the water pill - I meant the blood pressure one... lisinopril, that's the one.
[#5] AGENT: Got it, lisinopril for blood pressure. I still need your date of birth to look up your prescription—can you give me that?
CALLER: Oh yes, sorry honey. It's May 12th, 1947.
    (agent system action #8: verify_identity({"patient":"Gloria Hart","dob":"05/12/1947"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Gloria Hart","home_store":"H-110","default_store":"H-110","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #11: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Gloria Hart"}) -> success {"patient":"Gloria Hart","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-GH-FURO20","drug":"furosemide 20 mg","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":2,"store_id":"H-110","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","queued_refills":[]},{"rx_id":"RX-...)
[#13] AGENT: Thank you, Gloria. Let me pull up your prescriptions. Great, Gloria. Now let me find your lisinopril prescription. I found your lisinopril 10 mg, Gloria, but it has zero refills left. I can send a renewal request to Dr. Raj Patel—would you like me to do that?
CALLER: No refills? What do I do, honey?
[#16] AGENT: I can request a renewal from Dr. Patel right now, and he should get back to us. In the meantime, if you're running low and worried you might run out before he responds, a pharmacist here can look at whether we can give you a short emergency supply under state rules—but I can't promise that. Would you like me to go ahead and request the renewal?
CALLER: Oh, yes please, honey, go ahead and ask the doctor. I've only got about a week's worth left, so I hope he answers quick.
    (agent system action #19: request_renewal({"rx":"RX-GH-LISI10","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","store":"H-110"}) -> success {"status":"sent","rx_id":"RX-GH-LISI10","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","store_id":"H-110"})
[#22] AGENT: Perfect, Gloria. I've sent the renewal request to Dr. Patel. Since you're getting low on time, let me also flag our pharmacist to give you a call about whether an emergency supply might be possible while we wait for the doctor to respond.
CALLER: Oh, thank you, honey, that would be a relief. How long do you think it'll take to hear back?
[#25] AGENT: I wish I could say for sure, Gloria, but it depends on how quickly Dr. Patel's office processes it—could be a day or two, or sometimes longer. Our pharmacist will be calling you soon to talk about the emergency supply option, so that should help bridge the gap while we wait.
CALLER: Alright honey, thank you so much for your help. I'll wait to hear from the pharmacist then. Bye now.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S10.judged.1: Tells her plainly that lisinopril has no refills left.
S10.judged.2: Gives a rough timeline of about 1 to 2 business days.
S10.judged.3: Reads back the outcome slowly at the end.
S10.judged.4: Says lisinopril is refilled or ready.
S10.judged.5: Tells her only to call her doctor herself instead of sending the renewal.

JSON only.

message.content: {"S10.judged.1": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 13, "why": "Agent explicitly states lisinopril has zero refills left."}, "S10.judged.2": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 25, "why": "Agent says 'a day or two, or sometimes longer' as rough timeline."}, "S10.judged.3": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "No slow readback of outcome occurs at call's end."}, "S10.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never states lisinopril is refilled or ready."}, "S10.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 19, "why": "Agent sent renewal request itself, did not tell her to call doctor."}}
